name: manual_9b6312
claim: Treat saved harness drivers and run copies as immutable evidence: do not rewrite them to satisfy a review. Document the known limit in a README beside them and answer the comment with an evidence-backed decline.

decisions.notes: Four review comments on saved evaluator and driver copies were answered by a README note, keeping the record of what was actually run intact.

rationale: Four review comments on saved evaluator and driver copies were answered by a README note, keeping the record of what was actually run intact.
